# onetsolutions_project (Data Source)

Looks up a project of an organization by `id` or by `name`.

Projects are created in the console.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_project" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

output "production_project_id" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_project.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The UUID of the project. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `name` (String) The name of the project. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.

### Read-Only

- `domain_quota` (Number) The number of domains the project may hold.
